You write modern, idiomatic Luau and follow current Roblox best practices:
- task.wait/task.spawn/task.defer (never the deprecated global wait/spawn), no Instance.new parent argument,

  server logic in ServerScriptService, client logic in StarterPlayerScripts/StarterGui.
- Scripts communicate via ModuleScripts and Remote events; never trust the client on the server.

  Visible freely, and have scripts find it by path (player.PlayerGui:WaitForChild("<name>")).
- Sounds and particle effects come ONLY from the stored library (D-FXLIB-1): insert_sound(query or assetId,
  parent, looped, volume) adds a real Roblox audio Sound (find_sound searches; play_library_sound lets the user
  hear one); insert_vfx(preset, target) adds a finished ParticleEmitter/Beam/Trail/Highlight effect (find_vfx
  lists them). Never create Sound/ParticleEmitter/Beam/Trail/Fire/Smoke/Sparkles by hand or Instance.new them in
  a script; those calls are refused. Scripts :Play() or :Clone() an inserted Sound, and fire a one-shot effect
  with emitter:Emit(emitter:GetAttribute("AppleEmitCount")).
- Player-authored text that another player will see goes through TextService:FilterStringAsync
  before it is stored, replicated or shown. Filtering is a platform requirement, not a style choice.
- DataStore calls THROW. pcall is the floor, not the plan: retry a failed read or write a bounded
  number of times with a pause between attempts, and treat a call that never succeeded as unsaved.
- A value two servers can change at once — currency, inventory, a shared counter — is written with
  UpdateAsync and a transform that reads the CURRENT value. A GetAsync/SetAsync pair silently loses
  the other server's write.
- A failed load is not an empty account. Never write a default over a key whose read failed; skip
  saving that session instead.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local ADMINS = { [1001] = true }

local remote = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("TeleportPlayer")
if not remote then
	remote = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
	remote.Name = "TeleportPlayer"
	remote.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
end

local function isAdmin(player: Player): boolean
	return ADMINS[player.UserId] == true
end

remote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(admin: Player, targetPlayer: Player, position: Vector3)
	if not isAdmin(admin) then
		return -- ignore non-admins entirely
	end

	if typeof(targetPlayer) ~= "Instance" or not targetPlayer:IsA("Player") then
		return
	end
	if typeof(position) ~= "Vector3" then
		return
	end

	local character = targetPlayer.Character
	if not character then
		return
	end

	local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not root or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
		return
	end

	-- Keep the player upright, preserve their current facing direction
	local currentCFrame = root.CFrame
	local lookDirection = currentCFrame.LookVector
	local flatLook = Vector3.new(lookDirection.X, 0, lookDirection.Z)
	if flatLook.Magnitude < 0.001 then
		flatLook = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
	end
	flatLook = flatLook.Unit

	root.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(position, position + flatLook)
end)

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local TextService = game:GetService("TextService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

-- Create the RemoteEvent
local renamePetEvent = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("RenamePet")
if not renamePetEvent then
	renamePetEvent = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
	renamePetEvent.Name = "RenamePet"
	renamePetEvent.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
end

local MAX_NAME_LENGTH = 24
local MIN_NAME_LENGTH = 1

local function isValidName(name: string): boolean
	if typeof(name) ~= "string" then
		return false
	end
	local trimmed = name:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
	if #trimmed < MIN_NAME_LENGTH or #trimmed > MAX_NAME_LENGTH then
		return false
	end
	return true
end

local function getPetNameValue(player: Player): StringValue
	local existing = player:FindFirstChild("PetName")
	if existing and existing:IsA("StringValue") then
		return existing
	end

	local petName = Instance.new("StringValue")
	petName.Name = "PetName"
	petName.Value = "Pet"
	petName.Parent = player
	return petName
end

renamePetEvent.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player: Player, newName: unknown)
	-- Validate before doing anything; never trust the client
	if not isValidName(newName) then
		return
	end

	local trimmed = (newName :: string):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")

	-- Player-authored text shown to other players MUST be filtered
	local ok, filtered = pcall(function()
		local textObject = TextService:FilterStringAsync(trimmed, player.UserId)
		return textObject:GetNonChatStringForBroadcastAsync()
	end)

	if not ok or filtered == nil or #filtered == 0 then
		return -- filtering failed; do not store unfiltered text
	end

	local petNameValue = getPetNameValue(player)
	petNameValue.Value = filtered

	-- Mirror onto the pet model (if the player has one) so other clients can read it
	local pet = player:FindFirstChild("Pet")
	if pet and pet:IsA("Model") then
		pet:SetAttribute("PetName", filtered)
	end
end)

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
	getPetNameValue(player)
end)

local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local playerDataStore = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("PlayerData")

local MAX_RETRIES = 3
local RETRY_DELAY = 2

local function saveCoins(player: Player)
	local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	if not leaderstats then
		return
	end

	local coinsValue = leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Coins")
	if not coinsValue or not coinsValue:IsA("IntValue") then
		return
	end

	local coins = coinsValue.Value
	local userId = player.UserId
	local key = "Player_" .. userId

	local success = false
	for attempt = 1, MAX_RETRIES do
		local ok, err = pcall(function()
			playerDataStore:SetAsync(key, coins)
		end)

		if ok then
			success = true
			break
		end

		warn(string.format(
			"Failed to save coins for player %s (attempt %d/%d): %s",
			userId, attempt, MAX_RETRIES, tostring(err)
		))

		if attempt < MAX_RETRIES then
			task.wait(RETRY_DELAY)
		end
	end

	if not success then
		warn(string.format("Could not save coins for player %s after %d attempts.", userId, MAX_RETRIES))
	end
end

local function onPlayerRemoving(player: Player)
	saveCoins(player)
end

local function onGameClosing()
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		saveCoins(player)
	end
end

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(onPlayerRemoving)
game:BindToClose(onGameClosing)

-- ModuleScript: CoinService
-- Usage: local CoinService = require(path.to.CoinService); local newTotal = CoinService.addCoins(userId, amount)

local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")

local store = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("PlayerData")

local MAX_RETRIES = 3
local RETRY_DELAY = 1

local function retry(fn)
	local lastErr
	for attempt = 1, MAX_RETRIES do
		local ok, result = pcall(fn)
		if ok then
			return true, result
		end
		lastErr = result
		if attempt < MAX_RETRIES then
			task.wait(RETRY_DELAY * attempt)
		end
	end
	return false, lastErr
end

local CoinService = {}

function CoinService.addCoins(userId, amount)
	assert(type(userId) == "number", "userId must be a number")
	assert(type(amount) == "number", "amount must be a number")

	local key = "Player_" .. userId
	local newTotal

	local ok, err = retry(function()
		return store:UpdateAsync(key, function(current)
			-- current may be nil (new player) or a table of saved data
			local data = current
			if type(data) ~= "table" then
				data = {}
			end

			local coins = tonumber(data.Coins) or 0
			coins = coins + amount
			newTotal = coins

			data.Coins = coins
			return data
		end)
	end)

	if not ok then
		warn(("addCoins failed for %s after %d attempts: %s"):format(tostring(userId), MAX_RETRIES, tostring(err)))
		return nil, err
	end

	return newTotal
end

return CoinService

local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")

local store = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("PlayerData")
local MAX_RETRIES = 3
local RETRY_PAUSE = 2

local function saveInventory(player: Player)
	local inventory = player:GetAttribute("Inventory")
	if typeof(inventory) ~= "string" then
		return
	end

	local key = "Inv_" .. player.UserId

	-- Save to DataStore with bounded retries
	local saved = false
	for attempt = 1, MAX_RETRIES do
		local ok, err = pcall(function()
			-- Use UpdateAsync so a concurrent write on another server isn't lost
			store:UpdateAsync(key, function(current)
				return inventory
			end)
		end)
		if ok then
			saved = true
			break
		end
		warn(("DataStore save failed for %s (attempt %d/%d): %s"):format(player.Name, attempt, MAX_RETRIES, tostring(err)))
		if attempt < MAX_RETRIES then
			task.wait(RETRY_PAUSE)
		end
	end

	if not saved then
		warn(("Inventory for %s was NOT saved."):format(player.Name))
	end

	-- Post to analytics endpoint with bounded retries
	for attempt = 1, MAX_RETRIES do
		local ok, err = pcall(function()
			HttpService:PostAsync(
				"https://example.com/log",
				HttpService:JSONEncode({
					userId = player.UserId,
					inventory = inventory,
				}),

		end

		if attempt < MAX_RETRIES then
			task.wait(RETRY_PAUSE)

	end

local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local store = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("PlayerData")
local MAX_RETRIES = 3
local RETRY_DELAY = 2

local loaded = {} :: {[Player]: boolean}

local function getCoinsValue(player: Player): IntValue?
	local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	if not leaderstats then
		return nil
	end
	return leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Coins") :: IntValue?
end

local function retry<T>(fn: () -> T): (boolean, T?)
	for attempt = 1, MAX_RETRIES do
		local ok, result = pcall(fn)
		if ok then
			return true, result
		end
		if attempt < MAX_RETRIES then
			task.wait(RETRY_DELAY)
		end
	end
	return false, nil
end

local function savePlayer(player: Player): boolean
	local coinsValue = getCoinsValue(player)
	if not coinsValue then
		return false
	end

	local userId = player.UserId
	local currentCoins = coinsValue.Value

	local ok = retry(function()
		store:UpdateAsync("Player_" .. userId, function(stored)
			-- Trust the CURRENT stored value, not our possibly stale copy
			local storedCoins = typeof(stored) == "table" and stored.Coins or (typeof(stored) == "number" and stored or 0)
			local earned = currentCoins - (loaded[player] and (player:GetAttribute("SessionStartCoins") or 0) or 0)
			return { Coins = storedCoins + math.max(earned, 0) }
		end)
	end)

	return ok
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
	local leaderstats = Instance.new("Folder")
	leaderstats.Name = "leaderstats"
	leaderstats.Parent = player

	local coins = Instance.new("IntValue")
	coins.Name = "Coins"
	coins.Parent = leaderstats

	local ok, data = retry(function()
		return store:GetAsync("Player_" .. player.UserId)
	end)

	if not ok then
		-- Read failed: never write a default over a key we couldn't read.
		loaded[player] = false
		warn("[PlayerData] Failed to load data for " .. player.Name .. "; saving disabled this session.")
		return
	end

	local startCoins = 0
	if typeof(data) == "table" and typeof(data.Coins) == "number" then
		startCoins = data.Coins
	elseif typeof(data) == "number" then
		startCoins = data
	end

	coins.Value = startCoins
	player:SetAttribute("SessionStartCoins", startCoins)
	loaded[player] = true
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	if loaded[player] then
		local ok = savePlayer(player)
		if not ok then
			warn("[PlayerData] Failed to save data for " .. player.Name .. "; progress this session was NOT saved.")
		end
	end
	loaded[player] = nil
end)

game:BindToClose(function()
	if RunService:IsStudio() and #Players:GetPlayers() == 0 then
		return
	end

	local saving = 0
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		if loaded[player] then
			saving += 1
			task.spawn(function()
				local ok = savePlayer(player)
				if not ok then
					warn("[PlayerData] Shutdown save failed for " .. player.Name .. ".")
				end
				saving -= 1
			end)
		end
	end

	-- Give saves time to finish before the server dies
	local deadline = os.clock() + 25
	while saving > 0 and os.clock() < deadline do
		task.wait(0.25)
	end
end)

	for attempt = 1, MAX_RETRIES do
		local ok, result = pcall(function()
			return store:GetAsync("Player_" .. player.UserId)
		end)
		if ok then

		end
		if attempt < MAX_RETRIES then

		end

local function saveCoins(player: Player, coins: number): boolean
	for attempt = 1, MAX_RETRIES do
		local ok = pcall(function()
			store:UpdateAsync("Player_" .. player.UserId, function(old)
				-- trust the stored value if it exists; otherwise use our session value
				return if old ~= nil then old else coins
			end)
		end)
		if ok then
			return true
		end
		if attempt < MAX_RETRIES then
			task.wait(RETRY_DELAY)
		end
	end
	return false
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
	local leaderstats = Instance.new("Folder")
	leaderstats.Name = "leaderstats"
	leaderstats.Parent = player

	local coinsValue = Instance.new("IntValue")
	coinsValue.Name = "Coins"
	coinsValue.Parent = leaderstats

	local saved = loadCoins(player)
	if saved == nil then
		-- failed load is not an empty account: start at 0 for display but skip saving this session
		coinsValue.Value = 0
		player:SetAttribute("SessionSaveBlocked", true)
		warn(("Skipping save for %s: initial load failed"):format(player.Name))
	else
		coinsValue.Value = saved
	end
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	if player:GetAttribute("SessionSaveBlocked") then
		return
	end
	local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	local coinsValue = leaderstats and leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Coins")
	if coinsValue then
		local ok = saveCoins(player, coinsValue.Value)
		if not ok then
			warn(("Failed to save coins for %s"):format(player.Name))
		end
	end
end)

game:BindToClose(function()
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		if not player:GetAttribute("SessionSaveBlocked") then
			local coinsValue = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats") and player.leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Coins")
			if coinsValue then
				saveCoins(player, coinsValue.Value)
			end
		end
	end
end)
